fields.name: api_key
fields.help: BytePlus ModelArk API key (console.byteplus.com > ModelArk > API keys, ap-southeast-1), sent as Authorization: Bearer. Activate the Seedance/Seedream models first.

adapter.terms: Output URLs are valid for 24 hours; save results promptly. Model availability requires activation in the ModelArk console.

me.note: GET /contents/generations/tasks?page_num=1&page_size=1: lists the latest video task; used as the credential check (no account endpoint).

generate_image.note: POST /images/generations {model (required: a Seedream model id or endpoint id), prompt, image (reference URL/base64), size (e.g. 2K or 2048x2048), seed, response_format: url} -> {data: [{url, size}]}: synchronous; URLs are valid for 24 h (all images in raw.data).

generate_video.note: POST /contents/generations/tasks {model (required, e.g. seedance-1-5-pro-251215 or dreamina-seedance-2-0-260128), content: [{type: text, text}], ratio (16:9, 9:16, 1:1 …), duration (s)} -> {id}; poll with get_job. Text-to-video only: an image_url content entry cannot be added conditionally, so image_url is not sent.

get_job.note: GET /contents/generations/tasks/{id}: status queued|running|cancelled|succeeded|failed|expired; content.video_url (valid 24 h) when succeeded.

not_offered.list_items: No content-item resource; the task list (GET /contents/generations/tasks) is generation history.
not_offered.delete_item: No content-item resource (DELETE /contents/generations/tasks/{id} cancels or deletes a generation task).

evidence: host ark.ap-southeast.bytepluses.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 4/4 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 401 too, so the host authenticates before routing
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 4/4 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
